earlier_scan.source_named: Only Donohue 1996 'Some trade languages of insular South-East Asia and Irian Jaya' (brief overview) and Ethnologue entries; no phonological description of Iha-based Pidgin.

sources.note: Nothing; MED = wordlist_or_less (Donohue 1996), AES = extinct, 'Second language only'. No grammar, sketch or phonology reference listed.
On the pidgin only: 'It is the basis of a pidgin used as the local trade language.' Phonology section (for Iha proper, not the pidgin) gives segment inventories only; no stress/accent statement.

sources.citation: Walker, Katherine & Nikolaus P. Himmelmann. (submitted/ms, ca. 2022). Iha [grammar sketch] and unpublished 'Iha Phonology Sketch' (Universitat zu Koln, DoBeS/ELDP Iha documentation project).
